readings: Return one unrounded row with (1) the average, across invoices with at least one non-NULL Invoice_Line_Items.product_price, of each invoice’s mean non-NULL line-item product_price, and (2) the average number of Invoice_Line_Items rows across all rows in Invoices, counting invoices with no line items as zero.

Return one unrounded row with (1) the average, across invoices with at least one non-NULL Invoice_Line_Items.product_price, of each invoice’s mean non-NULL line-item product_price, and (2) the average number of Invoice_Line_Items rows across invoices that have at least one line item.

Return one unrounded row with (1) the average, across invoices with at least one non-NULL Invoice_Line_Items.product_price, of each invoice’s mean non-NULL line-item product_price, and (2) the average number of Invoice_Line_Items rows across those same invoices with at least one non-NULL product_price.
queries:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(li.product_price) AS mean_product_price,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count
FROM invoice_stats

WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(product_price) AS mean_price,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
  AVG(mean_price),
  AVG(line_item_count)
FROM invoice_stats

SELECT
    AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price,
    AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
    HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
)
